description: Structured, editable catalog of real-world page layout recipes. The page builder flattens every layout group for matching and exposes every layout ID as an explicit pageType option.

layoutGroups.name: Tools & Utilities
layoutGroups.description: Focused browser tools and task-oriented utility experiences.

layouts.name: Online Tool Page
layouts.purpose: Help visitors understand, use, and trust one focused online tool.
outline: Single H1 naming the tool and outcome
Short direct explanation and trust notes
Primary tool workspace with clear inputs and output
How-to steps and supported formats or limits
Visible FAQs with matching FAQ schema
seoNotes: Use SoftwareApplication/Product schema only when accurate; include visible steps as HowTo data when useful.
Keep the page explanation, H1, metadata, and tool behavior aligned.
If the tool is client-only, prerender the page frame, text, FAQs, and JSON-LD.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Keep the tool task prominent on mobile, stack controls and results in task order, and avoid horizontal overflow.
